notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
Dear Artists,
We have prepared a new patch that fixes several bugs:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with saving painting progress; 
[*] Fixed a bug with the gold balance at the end of the day. 
[/list]
Thanks for your feedback! 
Gallery Team

notes.title: Bug fixes and other improvements!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288097/94e674c2b030c09792c52108e1b493ced598a41e.png[/img]

Hello, dear artists! 
We have prepared a small update for you, it includes some very important changes that will improve your gaming experience:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the game from launching without internet connection;
[*] Removed tutorial with wardrobe, which led to soft-lock;
[*] Various visual improvements and fixes.
[/list]
If you encountered a bug or problem in the game — please contact our support team, we will try to solve your problem as soon as possible. 

Thanks for playing!
